implementation_notes: Strict TypeScript plus a formatter removes most ambiguity. Name discriminated-union members after the state, narrow with `switch` on the discriminant so exhaustiveness is checked, and prefer explicit return types on exported functions so the signature is documentation.
idiom_name: narrowed switch on a discriminant + exported explicit types
pitfalls: Index signatures typed `any` so no narrowing is possible
